name: spreadsheets
description: Use this skill when a user requests to create or modify or work with spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xls) to do any of the following: - Create a new workbook/sheet with proper formulas, cell/number formatting, and structured layout - Read or analyze tabular data (filter, aggregate, pivot, compute metrics) directly in a sheet - Modify an existing workbook without breaking existing formulas or references - Visualize data with in-sheet charts/tables and sensible formatting - Recalculate/evaluate formulas to update results after changes
